incident-bot: [PAGE] 2026-03-18 22:46 UTC - alert: model-serving-high-error-rate - route=global, severity=page. error_rate=6.8% (threshold=5%) -> paging #eng-oncall :rotating_light:
PagerDutyBot: Pager triggered for oncall group 'eng-oncall' (policy=global_paging). Escalation level 1.
Lina M: ACK. I'm up. Jumping on bridge: https://calls.redwood.com/bridge/xyz789. Anyone see customer reports?
Raj S: looking. Errors are mostly 4xx from malformed requests hitting a new validation rule in API gateway. Not actual model failures. A lot of retries from internal jobs too.
Tom B: omg, those gateway 4xxs shouldn't have triggered this alert. The alert filters didn't include status_class. It looks like a route mis-config: backend 5xxs only intended to page.
Claire G: Support has 3 customers flagged but their errors are client-side (bad payload). I don't think customers are actually failing to get responses. Low customer impact.
Lina M: ok mitigation plan: 1) suppress global paging for this alert to ticket so we stop waking everyone, 2) patch alert rule to only include 5xx for paging use-case, 3) add per-route dashboards so we can distinguish gateway vs worker errors.
Tom B: I'll flip route to ticket and add a short 'for: 10m' to prevent flapping. Applying now:
```yaml
alert: model-serving-high-error-rate
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status!~"2.."}[1m])) by (route)
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: ticket
  scope: route
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.social/runbooks/model-errors
```
OpsBot: Change applied by Tom B: severity=ticket for alert model-serving-high-error-rate; for=10m added. Notifications updated.
incident-bot: Paging suppressed. Incident remains active for investigation.
Raj S: root cause: a deploy replaced a validation library and it started returning 400 for certain legacy client payloads. The deploy note didn't mention backwards-compat behavior. Nexus job retries amplified the noise.
Tom B: immediate: revert validation bump for gateway in eu-central, and pause retrying internal jobs for 30m. Doing the revert now.
PagerDutyBot: Revert deployment queued -> rollout-id: roll-2026-03-18-4001.
Claire G: support will reach out to impacted customers and confirm no data loss.
Lina M: good. While we wait, let's sketch follow-ups for post-incident: - dashboard per-route (5xx/4xx/p95) by region - update alert routing rules: page only if aggregated 5xx > 15% OR any critical route 5xx > 5% for >5m - ensure alerts include 'route' and 'status_class' labels - create a severity matrix doc mapping page vs ticket vs slack-notify - add runbook section for deploy validation regressions
Raj S: I'll open RED-ALERT-5501 for eng-alerting to implement new routing rules and dashboards. Assigning to Claire + Tom.
Tom B: quick draft of severity matrix (pasting):
```json
{
  "severity_matrix": [
    {"condition":"total_5xx_pct > 15%","action":"page","channels":["eng-oncall","ops-incident"]},
    {"condition":"route_5xx_pct > 5% and route in critical_routes","action":"page","channels":["eng-oncall"]},
    {"condition":"any_4xx_spike","action":"ticket","channels":["eng-sre","eng-platform"]},
    {"condition":"non-user-facing_errors","action":"slack-notify","channels":["eng-alerting"]}
  ]
}
```
OpsBot: Created ticket RED-ALERT-5501 (implement routing + dashboards). Linked runbook: https://redwood.social/runbooks/alerts/severity-matrix.
Lina M: handoff note: my shift ends at 23:15 UTC. @Raj S please take the shift and watch for regressions. I'll leave the bridge open for 15 more minutes.
Raj S: taking handoff. I'll monitor for 45m. If error_rate > 8% or pages resume, I'll escalate to on-call rota.
incident-bot: Incident 'model-serving-high-error-rate' status changed to mitigated (paging suppressed, revert in progress). Record created and linked to RED-ALERT-5501.
Claire G: postmortem focus: communication gap on deploy changes, missing label for status_class in alerts, and routing policy too aggressive. I'll start a postmortem doc in #postmortems and pull in eng-alerting, platform, and support.
Tom B: follow-ups I'll take: - implement status_class filter in alert queries - add per-route `for: 5m` thresholds - add annotation with runbook and incident owner on alerts
OpsBot: Reminder: schedule a 1-hour alert-tuning working session next week and add stakeholders: eng-alerting, eng-platform, support. Tentative: 2026-03-22 16:00 UTC.
Lina M: thanks team. Closing my oncall now. If anything pops up @Raj S please ping here. :thumbsup:
Raj S: noted.
incident-bot: Thread closed by Lina M at 2026-03-18 23:19 UTC.
